ipodcoupling.help: Electronic coupling between two neighbor-list segments by POD2 (projection-operator diabatization) from one ground-state DFT calculation of their H-saturated supermolecule. Follows the IQM workflow (mapping, H-saturation, relaxation, DFT) and then runs PODCoupling instead of dftcoupling/bsecoupling; see podcoupling for the method.

job_file.help: name of jobfile to which jobs are written

functional.help: Exchange correlation functional used. You can also specify an exchange and a correlation functional

store_dft.help: If true, writes the orb file of the converged H-saturated supermolecule after the DFT step

include_linkers.help: If true, adds linker segments that are covalently bonded to both segments (found from bond connectivity; no segment-type list as for linker_names in IQM) to the supermolecule, positioned under periodic boundary conditions. Their atoms belong to neither fragment in the POD2 calculation.

podcoupling.help: Options of the POD2 coupling calculation on the converged supermolecule

levA.help: Number of orbitals of fragment A counted from the HOMO/LUMO gap, occupied and virtual together, as levA in dftcoupling: 1 covers HOMO and LUMO, 2 covers HOMO-1 to LUMO+1, etc.

levB.help: Same as levA, for fragment B
